title: Mycobacterium Tuberculosis: Diagnosis and Drug Resistance
subject: Microbiology
preview: Tuberculosis diagnosis integrates clinical suspicion with microbiological tests such as nucleic acid amplification and culture.
quickRevision: Tuberculosis diagnosis integrates clinical suspicion with microbiological tests such as nucleic acid amplification and culture.
Rapid molecular tests can identify Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and selected resistance markers.
Drug susceptibility testing and public-health context guide treatment selection.

sections.title: Pathophysiology & identification
points: Tuberculosis diagnosis integrates clinical suspicion with microbiological tests such as nucleic acid amplification and culture.
Acid-fast microscopy may demonstrate organisms but does not fully characterize drug resistance.

sections.title: Diagnostic and treatment connections
points: Rapid molecular tests can identify Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and selected resistance markers.
Drug susceptibility testing and public-health context guide treatment selection.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: A negative smear does not exclude tuberculosis, especially in paucibacillary disease.

quiz.question: Which test can rapidly identify MTB genetic material and selected resistance markers?
quiz.explanation: Molecular nucleic acid amplification test. Tuberculosis diagnosis integrates clinical suspicion with microbiological tests such as nucleic acid amplification and culture.
